errors.description: The subtraction of two atan2 results gives a signed angle that can be negative or fall outside the 0°–180° range. The stated curl thresholds therefore depend on landmark orientation and can misclassify an otherwise identical curl. The angle must be wrapped and converted to an unsigned joint angle before applying these thresholds.
errors.evidence: The angle is defined as `arctan2(c_y - b_y, c_x - b_x) - arctan2(a_y - b_y, a_x - b_x)`; the curl stages use `angle > 160°` and `angle < 30°`.

errors.description: IoU is specified as an area-overlap metric, but the described model output consists of landmark coordinates. The manuscript does not define regions or masks derived from those landmarks, ground-truth areas, or an annotation procedure, so the stated IoU evaluation is not defined for the reported outputs as described.
errors.evidence: The model “returns a set of landmark coordinates”; the metrics are listed as `MSE = ...` and `IoU = (Area of Overlap) / (Area of Union)`, with no area construction or ground-truth definition.

errors.description: The claimed accuracy and speed gains cannot be checked from the supplied results: no baseline or optimized metric values, sample counts, or variability are reported. The stated table has no entries, and the results section leaves “Key statistics include:” blank. Thus the 20% IoU increase and 30% processing-time reduction are unsupported by the presented evidence.
errors.evidence: The results say “Table 1 summarizes” performance but provide only a caption, then say “Key statistics include:” without values. The conclusion nevertheless claims “a 20% increase” in IoU and “a reduction in processing time by approximately 30%.”
